description: Taussoe glm-long-context fork c32abe92 and Vontra MLX 4-bit MTP weights. Two ranks load their halves directly from the immutable full checkpoint using the engine RankReader; no persistent split copies are needed. One stream, 458,752-token window, native MTP without an external drafter, one GiB GPU conversation cache and a 64 GiB disk prompt cache. The engine automatically loads the vision tower on rank zero. The 116 GB per-node peak is a conservative estimate; physical execution is unverified.
title: GLM-5.3 Flash MLX TensorFold dual Spark (taussoe)
